estimates.t: There have been no material changes to the Partnership's critical accounting estimates from those disclosed in Item 7, “Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” of the 2025 Form 10-K.

estimates.name: Subsequent Events
estimates.t: In November 2026, the Partnership and its lender entered into the third amendment to the Loan Agreement that renewed and extended the Credit Facility for two additional years to March 1, 2029.
